322: Option<std::vector<Index>> SearchEngine::search_phrase(std::string_view query) const {
323:     const std::vector<std::string> words = tokenize(query);
324:     if (words.empty()) {
325:         return std::nullopt;
326:     }
327: 
328:     const auto first_word = inverted_index.find(words.front());
329:     if (first_word == inverted_index.end()) {
330:         return std::nullopt;
331:     }
332: 
333:     std::vector<Index> matches;
334:     for (const Index& start : first_word->second) {
335:         std::vector<Index> phrase_match{start};
336:         bool is_phrase = true;
337: 
338:         for (size_t offset = 1; offset < words.size(); ++offset) {
339:             const auto found = inverted_index.find(words[offset]);
340:             if (found == inverted_index.end()) {
341:                 return std::nullopt;
342:             }
343: 
344:             const auto next = std::ranges::find_if(found->second, [&](const Index& index) {
345:                 return index.book_id == start.book_id && index.chapter_id == start.chapter_id &&
346:                        index.line == start.line && index.word_idx == start.word_idx + offset;
347:             });
348: 
349:             if (next == found->second.end()) {
350:                 is_phrase = false;
351:                 break;
352:             }
353: 
354:             phrase_match.push_back(*next);
355:         }
356: 
357:         if (is_phrase) {
358:             matches.insert(matches.end(), phrase_match.begin(), phrase_match.end());
359:         }
360:     }
361: 
362:     if (matches.empty()) {
363:         return std::nullopt;
364:     }
365: 
366:     std::ranges::sort(matches, {}, cmpr);
367:     return matches;

444: Option<std::vector<Index>> SearchEngine::search_near(std::string_view query, size_t dis) const {
445:     const std::vector<std::string> words = tokenize(query);
446:     if (words.empty()) {
447:         return std::nullopt;
448:     }
449: 
450:     if (words.size() == 1) {
451:         return search_or(query);
452:     }
453: 
454:     const std::string& word1 = words[0];
455:     const std::string& word2 = words[1];
456: 
457:     const auto first_word = inverted_index.find(word1);
458:     const auto second_word = inverted_index.find(word2);
459:     if (first_word == inverted_index.end() || second_word == inverted_index.end()) {
460:         return std::nullopt;
461:     }
462: 
463:     std::vector<Index> matches;
464: 
465:     for (const Index& first : first_word->second) {
466:         for (const Index& second : second_word->second) {
467:             if (first.book_id != second.book_id || first.chapter_id != second.chapter_id ||
468:                 first.line != second.line) {
469:                 continue;
470:             }
471: 
472:             const size_t distance = first.word_idx > second.word_idx
473:                                         ? first.word_idx - second.word_idx
474:                                         : second.word_idx - first.word_idx;
475:             if (distance <= dis) {
476:                 matches.push_back(first);
477:                 matches.push_back(second);
478:             }
479:         }
480:     }
481:

484:     }

491: Context get_context_range(const std::vector<Book>& books, const Index& idx) {
492:     if (idx.book_id >= books.size()) {
493:         return {};
494:     }
495:     const Book& book = books[idx.book_id];
496: 
497:     if (idx.line >= book.lines.size() || is_blank_line(book.lines[idx.line])) {
498:         return {};
499:     }
500:     size_t cur_begin = idx.line;
501: 
502:     while (cur_begin > 0 && !is_blank_line(book.lines[cur_begin - 1])) {
503:         cur_begin--;
504:     }
505: 
506:     size_t cur_end = idx.line + 1;
507:     while (cur_end < book.lines.size() && !is_blank_line(book.lines[cur_end])) {
508:         cur_end++;
509:     }
510: 
511:     Context context{
512:         .cur = LineRange{.begin = cur_begin, .end = cur_end},
513:     };
514: 
515:     size_t prev_end = cur_begin;
516:     while (prev_end > 0 && is_blank_line(book.lines[prev_end - 1])) {
517:         --prev_end;
518:     }
519: 
520:     size_t prev_begin = prev_end;
521:     while (prev_begin > 0 && !is_blank_line(book.lines[prev_begin - 1])) {
522:         --prev_begin;
523:     }
524: 
525:     if (prev_begin < prev_end) {
526:         context.prev = LineRange{.begin = prev_begin, .end = prev_end};
527:     }
528: 
529:     size_t next_begin = cur_end;

531:         ++next_begin;
